in.other_title: Transfer a formal bound to the open LLM oversight event
in.rationale: A common state and independently supported gap budgets are needed before the formal bound can reach the LLM protocol.

out.other_title: Literal formal-history versus text-transcript tagging is vacuous
out.rationale: A literal disjoint-tag embedding is proved vacuous; the shared-abstraction problem remains open.

rules: Every record and link keeps its recorded state; most are PROPOSED (AI-drafted, unreviewed). Say so when you use them.
A link is a recorded connection, not a verified relationship. An empty path_eligibility means the link may not be chained to carry a result into another setting.
Cite the paper and the PDF page in the record's sources, and check the paper before relying on a claim.
Counts are indexed records, not distinct ideas or papers. Absence of a record is a gap in the atlas, not evidence that nothing exists.
state_meaning: An open question or a link with unresolved obligations.
text: A useful text-to-formal transfer needs a source-faithful common state before the judge verdict, correct ideal and real marginals, and small error bounds obtained independently of the target false-acceptance outcomes. No such abstraction has been certified for Unkad.
title: Find a common state with independently bounded mismatch
